valuation.method: Forward EV/Adjusted EBITDA (FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA less Q3 2026 gross debt of $28.52B and noncontrolling interests of $9.14B, divided by 630.45M shares outstanding)
valuation.implied_by_close: At $89.75 ($94.24B EV), the close implies 10.24x base FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA ($9.20B); Street consensus targets (~$100-$102) imply ~10.9x-11.1x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/EBITDA on $9.20B base FY2027E EBITDA moves the target by $14.59/share (~15.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Full-year 2027 Adjusted EBITDA guidance and Permian Basin / Brazos Midstream volume integration
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and FY2027 guidance (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: Coverage is aggregate_only because individual analyst names and exact timestamps were not verified in full. Published Street consensus across ~22-23 analysts is a Moderate Buy with average targets of $99.55-$102.42 (range $93-$115), ~5-8 pp above our $95.00 base case. Recent firm-level targets following Q3 2026 earnings include Morgan Stanley ($112, Equal-Weight), Truist ($105, Hold), Mizuho ($101, Neutral), RBC Capital ($100, Sector Perform), Scotiabank ($97, Sector Perform), and Jefferies ($97, Hold).
